title: AI Platform Fee Audit Copilot Output Schema
description: Canonical envelope and report-specific payloads for human-readable and machine-readable outputs.

x-conventions.null_handling: null means unavailable, unsupported, or not applicable; zero means a verified zero.
x-conventions.amount_sign: Report summaries use economic direction where needed; expense and exposure components may use non-negative magnitudes. Source signs remain in source records.
x-conventions.rounding: Store unrounded calculation values. Display currency using the applicable currency exponent and ratios to two percentage points unless a platform requires otherwise.
x-conventions.evidence_rule: Material findings must cite at least one source reference and distinguish fact, user data, assumption, calculation, inference, and recommendation.
x-conventions.data_gap_rule: If more than 20% of in-scope transaction value is unclassified, or a blocking settlement source is absent, use data_gap unless a narrower reliable scope is explicitly reported.
